priorities.heading: Bring Down Gas and Grocery Prices
priorities.quote: James Byrd will fight to lower energy costs for everyday Wyomingites by supporting responsible domestic production, cutting the red tape that drives prices up, and ending the wasteful foreign wars that leave us footing the bill overseas instead of investing at home.

priorities.heading: Protect Public Lands
priorities.quote: James Byrd will stand against efforts to sell off or privatize the lands that belong to every Wyomingite, while working to keep them open for hunting, fishing, grazing, and recreation.

priorities.heading: Make Healthcare Affordable
priorities.quote: James Byrd will push to lower prescription drug costs, protect rural hospitals from closure, and make sure insurance actually works for the people paying into it.

cost-of-living.heading: Bring Down Gas and Grocery Prices
cost-of-living.quote: On groceries, he'll push back against corporate consolidation in food and agriculture that lets a handful of companies set prices while family producers get squeezed on both ends.
